findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：直接來自自家平台的間夜占比為五十%中段且年增，改善行銷效率；排除聯盟（B2B）後更高。
findings.excerpt: The mix of total room nights booked by consumers coming directly to our platforms was a mid-fifties percentage in 2025, and was higher if we exclude the room nights booked through affiliate programs (i.e., business-to-business). The mix of total room nights booked by consumers coming directly to our platforms increased year-over-year, which benefited our marketing efficiency for 2025.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：2025年平均績效行銷ROI小幅下滑，原因為付費流量組合變化與社群媒體支出增加。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, our average ROI was down slightly year-over-year driven by changes in paid traffic mix and increased social media spend.

findings.claim: Q3 2026 10-Q：商家模式占總訂房額 75%，去年同期 72%，因 Booking.com 由代理轉商家模式
findings.excerpt: These merchant services allow us to facilitate payments from travelers and offer secure, flexible transaction terms, such as varied payment forms, currencies, and timing. The mix of our total gross bookings generated on a merchant basis across the Company was 75% in the third quarter of 2026, an increase from 72% in the third quarter of 2025 due to the ongoing shift from agency to merchant
